items.exampleEn: A flea can jump very high.
Birds love to eat sunflower seeds.
Chimpanzees live in groups in the forest.
items.exampleZh: 黑猩猩成群住在森林裡。

items.exampleEn: The baby birds made little chirps.
items.exampleZh: 小鳥發出細細的啾啾聲。
知更鳥的胸口是橘色的。

items.exampleEn: The hotel has a view of the bay.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店可以看到海灣。

items.exampleEn: The cat is hiding behind a bush.

items.audioEn: The sunflowers in the field are taller than my dad.
items.audioZh: 田裡的向日葵比我爸爸還高。

items.sentenceEn: A robin is singing in the tree.
items.sentenceZh: 一隻知更鳥在樹上唱歌。

items.sentenceEn: Many boats are waiting in the bay.
items.sentenceZh: 很多船停在海灣裡等候。

items.stemEn: The ____ climbed the tree and ate a banana.
items.stemZh: 那隻黑猩猩爬上樹吃了一根香蕉。

items.stemEn: I heard the ____ of a small bird outside my window.
items.stemZh: 我聽到窗外一隻小鳥的啾啾聲。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, we went on a nature walk with a tour guide. First, we walked along a quiet bay. Then our tour guide showed us a robin in a bush, and we heard its happy chirp. Near a farm, there was a field of tall sunflowers. At the end, we visited a small zoo, where a chimpanzee ate a banana in front of us. My dog came with us, and the only bad part was that he got fleas.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們跟著導遊去大自然散步。我們先沿著一個安靜的海灣走。接著導遊讓我們看灌木叢裡的一隻知更鳥，我們還聽到牠快樂的啾啾聲。農場附近有一大片高高的向日葵。最後我們去了一座小動物園，一隻黑猩猩就在我們面前吃香蕉。我的狗也跟我們一起去，唯一不好的是牠身上有了跳蚤。

options: 一艘停在海灣裡的大船

questions.questionZh: 這次散步唯一不好的事是什麼？
options: 他們在森林裡迷路了很久

items.promptZh: 我們家門前有一些灌木。
referenceEn: There are some bushes in front of our house.
We have some bushes in front of our house.
rubricZh: 「灌木」用 bush，這裡用複數 bushes
「在⋯前面」可寫例如 in front of

items.instructionZh: 用 sunflower 造一個句子，說說向日葵的樣子，或你在哪裡看過向日葵。
referenceEn: I saw many sunflowers on a farm.
rubricZh: sunflower 是可數名詞（例如 a sunflower、sunflowers）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 Sunflowers are）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似事實不精確："The sunflower always turns to the sun." 只有未開花的幼株會追日，成熟向日葵固定朝東；建議改 "Sunflowers usually face the sun." 或換內容。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Birds love to eat sunflower seeds."（原 "The sunflower always turns to the sun."）
